name: GoJom
all_locations: Lima, Callao Region, Peru; Lima, Lima Province, Peru
long_description: GoJom is a One Stop Shop for Real Estate Solutions. It’s technology creates a  faster and easier way to buy, sell and rent properties in LaTam.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Entrepreneur with experience as investment banker and asset manager in U.S and LaTam.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Serial digital entrepreneur since 1997:
Adonde.com 1997, first search engine in Peru for 10 years.
AdondeVivir.com, Peru's leading real estate portal, first exit in Peru.
Turismoi.com, global distribution platform for tours in +10 countries.

Award-winning startups such as the BID Challenge Network with AdondeCompras.com in 2005, Digi Award (IAB PE) 2010 - AdondeVivir.com, 1st place of the Venture Day of IE Business School (Madrid) 2014 - Turismoi.es, Creatividad Empresarial 2019 - Turismoi.pe.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Self-taught software engineer with 20+ years of experience, now building AI systems that run in production. Co-Founder and CTO of GoJom (YC W22), Latin America's first intelligent real estate portal, and before that CTO of Turismoi. I led AI development at TEDI (500 Global LatAm B17), where the assistant I designed handled 40,000+ conversations with over 90% resolved without humans, and I am VP of Software Engineering at ConstructAI. I build LLM agents and RAG with Python, FastAPI and LangGraph.
